items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You’ve written a lot of lyrics to his works: Hackensack, Crepuscle with Nellie.

ctx.x: He said I was the only mother he wanted to put words to his music, and I was very flattered by that use of that half a word to describe me.
You’ve written a lot of lyrics to his works: Hackensack, Crepuscle with Nellie. One of my very favorites is Monk’s Dream.
